capabilities: Visualize Claude Code sessions as live activity on a 3D MRI brain
Inspect individual tool calls, parameters, outputs, and turn operation trees
Flag risky or stuck agent behavior with four watcher checks (guard, shield, reality, stuck)
Render vault notes as neurons with links as axons and browse them by region
Summarize session telemetry into workflow suggestions, lessons, replays, and cost tracking
disambiguation: Not an AI agent or assistant itself; it only listens locally and visualizes what an external coding agent is doing.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only. Downloads brain anatomy files (~3 MB) once from the plugin's own release, verified by SHA-256. Any agent can report events by posting JSON to the local listener, not just Claude Code.
problem: AI coding agents work invisibly in a terminal, so Obsidian users cannot see what the agent is doing, when it is stuck, or whether it is doing something risky.

relations.evidence: Works with Claude Code for now, through its hooks and telemetry.

summary: Visualization tool that shows Claude Code agent sessions—prompts, thinking, tool calls, subagents—as live activity on a 3D MRI brain with vault notes as neurons.
